key_features: JUST-RIGHT 10L MID-SIZE: A compact 10L pack — not too big, not too small. Sized for teens, festival-goers, students, young adults and active casual wearers who want a versatile everyday backpack without the bulk of a full school pack. Built for festivals, day trips, casual everyday wear, weekend errands, coffee runs, the campus crawl, after-school hangouts and the travel day-out rotation.

MULTIPLE POCKETS FOR DAILY ESSENTIALS: Multiple pockets give plenty of storage space for daily essentials — phone, wallet, keys, charger, ear buds, sunglasses, lip balm, hand sanitizer, snacks and a packable layer. Each item has a home so the rummage is shorter and the day moves faster. Built for the go-fast, festival, day-trip, weekend errand and casual everyday rotation.

ADJUSTABLE SHOULDER STRAPS: Adjustable shoulder straps let you wear at the length that works for you — dial in the carry across body type, layering and outfit. Wear higher on the back for a streetwear look or lower for the festival rotation. Built for teens, students, festival-goers, young adults and active casual wearers who want a personalized everyday carry.

COLLECTIBLE CHARM ON FRONT ZIPPER: A detachable collectible charm on the front zipper adds personal flair you can swap out, hand off, gift or trade. A small detail that makes the pack uniquely yours — the touch of personality that everyday backpacks usually skip. Built for teens, festival-goers, young adults and trend-aware students who want a backpack with personality and brand-name durability.
This product is not intended for children 12 years and under.
